Depending on the size of this release, there may be a human-readable changelog available on [the wiki page](https://github.com/embeddedt/ModernFix/wiki/Changelog).

## Changes since 5.24.3+1.21.1

  * [Spotless](https://github.com/embeddedt/ModernFix/commit/a39fb0a08240ed82aae3b907391f1e1bb3c7496f) - embeddedt
  * [Spotless](https://github.com/embeddedt/ModernFix/commit/a6eb99d23c8635d4eff4fa6a25543ba0c5e2ac05) - embeddedt
  * [Backport model compat fix from 1.21](https://github.com/embeddedt/ModernFix/commit/fd46baae21e3104d5b730fcc394f27c712d02a5c) - embeddedt
  * [Rewrite dynamic_sounds to consider sound duration when caching](https://github.com/embeddedt/ModernFix/commit/273bab7856adb0b2dedfe9ce8f97f3c760669dd8) - embeddedt
  * [Remove obsolete invalidation logic](https://github.com/embeddedt/ModernFix/commit/a2873755222bf61fe422de29dc71e34cccc7fad7) - embeddedt
  * [Enable worldgen_allocation by default](https://github.com/embeddedt/ModernFix/commit/8133198cc2a82664928ad062ed18e61f09b0e68f) - embeddedt
  * [Disable LazyYCondition logic in situations where it has no effect](https://github.com/embeddedt/ModernFix/commit/25976f3b870313502afe20913478090b9faf2f89) - embeddedt
  * [Fix idle tick time counting as scheduled tasks in F3 graph](https://github.com/embeddedt/ModernFix/commit/07592fb7089b9ac6dfa1602c65616806513c474d) - embeddedt
  * [Memoize `VanillaRegistres.createLookup`](https://github.com/embeddedt/ModernFix/commit/f71277eb6406ca74453875573fd68e9b1df15e7c) - embeddedt
  * [Deduplicate ResourcefulLib Highlight objects](https://github.com/embeddedt/ModernFix/commit/b30b319214c633d6caf84fa8f19d1138cd8878cc) - embeddedt
  * [Implement Forge ingredient invalidation correctly](https://github.com/embeddedt/ModernFix/commit/e411f11c0cc69f7bdb1c9ecf854c706ccb2f3fae) - embeddedt
  * [Add global properties file](https://github.com/embeddedt/ModernFix/commit/e30a7fccf2dfdaf9c6850863bfc6b702360e3a8d) - embeddedt
  * [Do not override user-specified `max.bg.threads`](https://github.com/embeddedt/ModernFix/commit/12a0414f61f19826adff7ca6a02c2b9a185bb96b) - embeddedt
  * [Tweak narrator mixin](https://github.com/embeddedt/ModernFix/commit/44322a7d07fa77da1c6e18b51b8c1bc60c67bac8) - embeddedt
  * [Mark Spark worker as daemon thread](https://github.com/embeddedt/ModernFix/commit/8d4a7c337469f3b48d8745947700cf5acd7f5a6d) - embeddedt
  * [Add mixin.feature.suppress_narrator_stacktrace to prevent some log spam on Linux (#590)](https://github.com/embeddedt/ModernFix/commit/29c1a479a45e28129f9b27511377379fcf31b2f2) - DerCommander323
  * [Make mixin.perf.thread_priorities limit background thread count as well](https://github.com/embeddedt/ModernFix/commit/ee6489fb699a059a802a6ac6aaba560eaa821727) - embeddedt
  * [Patch concurrency issue in ForgeRegistryTagManager](https://github.com/embeddedt/ModernFix/commit/87c977a3e6e3bfbda45a805642d94ebffb29ce14) - embeddedt
